request.input:
1boy, solo, full body, elegant three-quarter front standing pose, faint calm smile. Right black-gloved fingertips touch the bridge of his round eyeglasses, left arm rests across his waist. An opaque solid black smoky cloud floats on viewer-left at chest height; a round orange fireball with a long comet tail floats on viewer-right. No staff or wand.

Single game character selection full-body portrait, isolated on a clean white background.

Vertical composition. Entire character, headwear, hair, clothing, feet and signature props inside frame, comfortable small margins. No scenery, no other people.

Soft neutral studio illumination, clear face and hand shadows, restrained metal reflections, readable dark fabric, subtle ground contact shadow.
